values./system/description:
Sledgehammers are primitive weapons, used as tools before the Great War, for breaking ground or demolishing things. Although not usually considered as a powerful weapon, a strong person—or a super mutant—can wield one of these like a club, taking full advantage of the hammer’s weight.

A sledgehammer can accept one of the following mods which are installed with the Repair skill:

Sledgehammer: Puncturing, Heavy
